integrity: Full analytic proof supplied. Reproduction script contains finite diagnostics only. Historical comparisons include full texts of two closest papers and abstracts/introductory material for two others. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric, positive two-species Ricker map; exchange cycles only, local exponential stability only. Nonhyperbolic boundary nonlinear stability, nonswapping cycles, global basins, and independently established historical priority are not determined.
title: A sharp universal competition cutoff for attracting exchange two-cycles in a symmetric Ricker map
